reproduced.mechanism: the read handlers took no auth dependency at all; only api_control_rescan / api_control_doctor called _authorized(request)

evidence.rule: A non-loopback bind requires an operator-chosen token, and that same token is then required for every route, reads included; loopback keeps anonymous reads and --token auto.
evidence.token_auto_semantics: --token auto generates and prints a usable secret, but it is not an operator CHOICE, so a non-loopback bind refuses it (cli._resolve_serve raises ValueError -> exit 2; python -m resextract.dashboard with no --token refuses too). On loopback --token auto is unchanged: generated, printed, and it gates only POST /api/control/*.
